usage: jbus item propose [-h] --title TITLE --by BY [--where {chat,view,cli}]
                         [--owner OWNER]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --title TITLE
  --by BY               who proposes it
  --where {chat,view,cli}
                        where it was said
  --owner OWNER         who will do it
